  "decision-assign-exhibits-to-rated-display-cases": "WITH east AS (
  SELECT source_id, rated_kg FROM inspection_note WHERE case_code = 'east' ORDER BY revision_no DESC LIMIT 1
), west AS (
  SELECT source_id, rated_kg FROM inspection_note WHERE case_code = 'west' ORDER BY revision_no DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT e.exhibit_code AS east_exhibit, w.exhibit_code AS west_exhibit,
       e.east_visits + w.west_visits AS forecast_visits,
       east.source_id AS east_source, west.source_id AS west_source
FROM east
JOIN exhibit AS e ON e.load_kg <= east.rated_kg
CROSS JOIN west
JOIN exhibit AS w ON w.load_kg <= west.rated_kg AND w.exhibit_code <> e.exhibit_code
ORDER BY forecast_visits DESC, e.exhibit_code COLLATE BINARY, w.exhibit_code COLLATE BINARY
LIMIT 1",
  "decision-assign-festival-crates-to-return-bays": "WITH feasible AS (
  SELECT g.group_key, b.bay_key, g.crate_qty * r.metres AS crate_metres
  FROM crate_group AS g
  JOIN carry_route AS r ON r.group_key = g.group_key
  JOIN return_bay AS b ON b.bay_key = r.bay_key AND b.crate_limit >= g.crate_qty
), best AS (
  SELECT a.group_key AS g1, a.bay_key AS b1, a.crate_metres AS m1,
         b.group_key AS g2, b.bay_key AS b2, b.crate_metres AS m2
  FROM feasible AS a
  JOIN feasible AS b ON a.group_key COLLATE BINARY < b.group_key AND a.bay_key <> b.bay_key
  ORDER BY a.crate_metres + b.crate_metres, a.bay_key COLLATE BINARY, b.bay_key COLLATE BINARY
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT g1 AS group_key, b1 AS bay_key, m1 AS crate_metres FROM best
UNION ALL
SELECT g2, b2, m2 FROM best
ORDER BY group_key COLLATE BINARY",
  "decision-assign-grain-sensitive-blanks-to-remnants": "WITH choices AS (
  SELECT slot_no, slip_id, 'BUY' AS source_id, buy_cents AS cents, 0 AS remnants FROM cut_slip
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.slot_no, s.slip_id, r.remnant_id, 0, 1
  FROM cut_slip AS s
  JOIN paper_remnant AS r ON (r.sheet_w >= s.blank_w AND r.sheet_h >= s.blank_h)
    OR (s.turn_ok = 1 AND r.sheet_w >= s.blank_h AND r.sheet_h >= s.blank_w)
)
SELECT a.slip_id AS slip_one, a.source_id AS source_one,
       b.slip_id AS slip_two, b.source_id AS source_two, a.cents + b.cents AS purchase_cents
FROM choices AS a CROSS JOIN choices AS b
WHERE a.slot_no = 1 AND b.slot_no = 2 AND (a.remnants = 0 OR a.source_id <> b.source_id)
ORDER BY purchase_cents, a.remnants + b.remnants, a.source_id COLLATE BINARY, b.source_id COLLATE BINARY
LIMIT 1"
}

FROM (
  SELECT '"' || replace(s.plate_id, '"', '""') || '","' || replace(coalesce(s.field_label, ''), '"', '""') || '","' || replace(r.shelf_mark, '"', '""') || '","' || replace(s.slip_id, '"', '""') || '","' || replace(r.receipt_id, '"', '""') || '"' || char(10) AS csv_record
  FROM inspection_slips AS s

WITH east AS (
  SELECT source_id, rated_kg FROM inspection_note WHERE case_code = 'east' ORDER BY revision_no DESC LIMIT 1
), west AS (
  SELECT source_id, rated_kg FROM inspection_note WHERE case_code = 'west' ORDER BY revision_no DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT e.exhibit_code AS east_exhibit, w.exhibit_code AS west_exhibit,
       e.east_visits + w.west_visits AS forecast_visits,
       east.source_id AS east_source, west.source_id AS west_source
FROM east
JOIN exhibit AS e ON e.load_kg <= east.rated_kg
CROSS JOIN west
JOIN exhibit AS w ON w.load_kg <= west.rated_kg AND w.exhibit_code <> e.exhibit_code
ORDER BY forecast_visits DESC, e.exhibit_code COLLATE BINARY, w.exhibit_code COLLATE BINARY
LIMIT 1

WITH feasible AS (
  SELECT g.group_key, b.bay_key, g.crate_qty * r.metres AS crate_metres
  FROM crate_group AS g
  JOIN carry_route AS r ON r.group_key = g.group_key
  JOIN return_bay AS b ON b.bay_key = r.bay_key AND b.crate_limit >= g.crate_qty
), best AS (
  SELECT a.group_key AS g1, a.bay_key AS b1, a.crate_metres AS m1,
         b.group_key AS g2, b.bay_key AS b2, b.crate_metres AS m2
  FROM feasible AS a
  JOIN feasible AS b ON a.group_key COLLATE BINARY < b.group_key AND a.bay_key <> b.bay_key
  ORDER BY a.crate_metres + b.crate_metres, a.bay_key COLLATE BINARY, b.bay_key COLLATE BINARY
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT g1 AS group_key, b1 AS bay_key, m1 AS crate_metres FROM best
UNION ALL
SELECT g2, b2, m2 FROM best
ORDER BY group_key COLLATE BINARY
